name: auralis-vfs
description: Pip-installable Python library for vocal fatigue scoring from raw speech. Built on ECAPA-TDNN-VHE — returns a normalized fatigue score from any audio input.

name: voiceMonitor
description: Real-time vocal health monitoring tool — streams microphone input, runs auralis-vfs, and surfaces fatigue level and vocal load over a session.

name: VocalID
description: Open-source speaker verification framework using embedding cosine similarity on ECAPA-TDNN representations. Lightweight, no external APIs required.

name: faker-pk
description: Pakistani synthetic data library for realistic test fixtures — Urdu and Roman Urdu names, CNIC numbers, phone formats, addresses, and locale-aware records.

name: QueryVault
description: End-to-end LLM platform with real-time hallucination detection, structured logging, and a developer dashboard — hallucination rate, latency, P50/P95.

name: DataForge
description: Multi-agent system for automated EDA, cleaning, visualization, and report generation — autonomous data analysis pipelines built on CrewAI.

name: SecureCipher v2.0
description: Image encryption scheme scoring 100/100 against 14 benchmark algorithms across standard cryptographic security tests.
